segments.text: I'm not a smart man, but I know what love is.
My name's Forrest Gump. People call me Forrest Gump.
Sometimes I guess there just aren't enough rocks.
There's an awful lot you can tell about a person by their shoes.

note: Speaker attribution and transcripts from the supplied screenshot, checked with local Parakeet alignment. Gump is corrected from the ASR's Gum. The shoes excerpt ends after its first complete sentence; the later clause is excluded. The shorter greeting is kept in all-forrest-excerpts as an alternative to the longer introduction.
